name: Spain population 18-74 proxy
definition_or_use: broad adult denominator only; not active traders
notes: Age-band aggregation must be recomputed before use

name: Spain retail investment fund participant accounts
definition_or_use: observed accounts; rejected as active trading accounts
notes: Account count is not a person count and funds are not discretionary trading

name: Spain retail investors in capital markets
definition_or_use: reported retail-investor proxy; not active traders
notes: Use only as a ceiling check

name: EU retail CFD loss-rate disclosure range
definition_or_use: loss rate not trader population; never used as demand
notes: EU-wide and broker disclosures do not bridge to Spain active count

name: XTB active clients 2025
definition_or_use: top-down ceiling; global/mostly Europe but not Spain and not all trading categories
notes: Not used as Spain active traders

name: flatexDEGIRO customers 2025
definition_or_use: top-down EU ceiling; customer definition not active trader
notes: Not used as Spain active traders

name: Trading 212 global clients 2025
definition_or_use: global funded-account ceiling; not Spain and not active-trader bridge

name: Share of adults who actively trade in Spain
definition_or_use: default for survey design only; no verified Spain active-trader statistic
notes: Must be replaced by bridge survey

name: Share of active traders paying for a tool
definition_or_use: default for scenario only; no trading-specific observation

name: Monthly tool price paid
definition_or_use: observed comparable range across free and paid substitutes
notes: Range is not a willingness-to-pay estimate

name: Spain active retail trader count route A
definition_or_use: 18-74 proxy x active-trade share; wide range demonstrates unknown
notes: Do not use as launch market size

name: Spain paying-tool audience route A
definition_or_use: route A count x tool-payer share; no bridge data

name: Spain annual tool spend route A
definition_or_use: route A payer range x €5-€50 x 12; ranking/scenario only

name: EU active retail trader count
definition_or_use: not known; no accepted active-trader definition across EU

name: Community subscriber count
definition_or_use: not used because accessible public counts were not verified
notes: Do not infer audience from community size

name: Frechet lower-bound overlap
definition_or_use: for A and B when only marginals are known
notes: Formula only; substitute observed marginals after survey

name: Frechet upper-bound overlap
definition_or_use: min(P(A), P(B)) with missing observed marginals
